faq_a_trial: VOCA is paid (monthly, yearly, or lifetime). You can turn off auto-renew for monthly/yearly plans anytime in the App Store. Lifetime is a one-time purchase. No hidden fees.
faq_a_cancel: On iPhone: Settings → Apple ID → Subscriptions. You keep access until the end of the billing period. More in our Support page.
faq_a_langs: The app UI is available in nine languages: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, and Portuguese.
faq_q_widget: How do I set up the widget?
faq_a_widget: Long-press the Home Screen → tap “+” in the corner → search “VOCA” → choose a size and place the widget.
faq_q_device: Can I use it after switching devices?
faq_a_device: Yes. Install with the same Apple ID and tap Restore Purchases. Progress is stored on-device and does not sync automatically across devices.
faq_a_level: All levels—from beginners to advanced. Pick your English level in settings and switch Basic/Advanced examples anytime.
